task_spec: Implement parse_config(text) for `key = value` lines. A `#` starts an inline comment UNLESS it appears inside a double-quoted value, in which case it is a literal part of the value. Double-quoted values may contain spaces and `#`; the surrounding quotes are stripped from the result.

bugs.description: Inline-comment stripping uses line.index('#') with no awareness of quotes, so a '#' inside a quoted value is treated as a comment. For `color = "#ff0000"` it truncates the line to `color = "` , losing the value entirely (and the later quote-strip no longer applies). The comment scan must skip '#' characters that fall inside double quotes.

provenance.note: bespoke stateful interaction bug; no textbook pattern, no worked example
